accepted.title: Homeomorphism invariance of smooth-manifold tautological rings
accepted.text: For a closed oriented smooth d-manifold M, let π:E→BDiff⁺(M) be the universal oriented smooth M-bundle and T_πE its vertical tangent bundle. With rational coefficients, define R*(M)⊂H*(BDiff⁺(M);Q) as the subring generated by all generalized Miller–Morita–Mumford classes κ_c=π_!c(T_πE), for c∈H*(BSO(d);Q), where π_! is integration along the oriented fibre. If closed oriented smooth manifolds M₁ and M₂ are orientation-preservingly homeomorphic, do the same rational polynomial relations among the labelled generators κ_c hold in R*(M₁) and R*(M₂)? Equivalently, must the assignment κ_c(M₁)↦κ_c(M₂) induce an isomorphism of their tautological rings?

accepted.title: Positive tautological dimension without any connected Lie symmetry
accepted.text: For a closed oriented smooth d-manifold M, let π:E→BDiff⁺(M) be the universal oriented smooth M-bundle and T_πE its vertical tangent bundle. With rational coefficients, define R*(M)⊂H*(BDiff⁺(M);Q) as the subring generated by all generalized Miller–Morita–Mumford classes κ_c=π_!c(T_πE), for c∈H*(BSO(d);Q), where π_! is integration along the oriented fibre. Does there exist M for which the Krull dimension of R*(M) is positive, while the underlying topological manifold admits no smooth effective action by any nontrivial compact connected Lie group for any choice of smooth structure? For the graded rational ring, Krull dimension is understood after killing its nilradical, equivalently using its commutative even part.
accepted.citation: Question 5.3.10, held PDF physical p. 96, printed p. 82; Definition 1.2.1 physical p. 18.
accepted.subject: Geometry & Topology
accepted.scope_review: Read the complete physical p. 96 context and the circle-action lower-bound discussion in the current primary paper. The source explicitly quantifies over every smooth structure; lack of symmetry for just one chosen smoothing is insufficient. The trivial group is excluded under the intended nontrivial-symmetry convention, as otherwise the statement is vacuous. Rational graded-commutative Krull convention is made explicit; in even dimensions this is the ordinary commutative tautological ring.
accepted.duplicate_review: Global numbered and corpus comparison found no full equivalent. Manifolds with no Lie symmetry, vanishing tautological rings for aspherical manifolds, and positive ring dimension with an action are different targets.
accepted.literature_finding: Prigge 2025 gives vanishing for almost all fake quaternionic spaces and uses nontrivial connected compact Lie actions to obtain lower bounds in exceptions. This does not produce the required manifold with no action for any smoothing. The current bounded primary scan located no example or impossibility theorem for this full existential conjunction.

accepted.title: Euler-class kernels for smooth block bundles and smooth fibre bundles
accepted.text: For a closed oriented smooth d-manifold M, let π:E→BhAut⁺(M) be the universal oriented fibration with fibre M, where hAut⁺(M) is the monoid of orientation-preserving homotopy self-equivalences. Define its fibrewise Euler class e_fw=Δ*Δ_!(1) using the fibrewise diagonal Δ:E→E×_B E and its Poincaré-duality Umkehr map. Let E*(M)⊂H*(BhAut⁺(M);Q) be the subring generated by κ_i=π_!(e_fw^{i+1}) for i≥0. Smooth block diffeomorphisms are diffeomorphisms of M×Δ^k mapping M×σ to itself for every face σ; they need not commute with projection to Δ^k. Their classifying space is BDiff̃⁺(M). The natural maps BDiff⁺(M)→BDiff̃⁺(M)→BhAut⁺(M) induce maps from E*(M) to their rational cohomology rings. Determine the kernel K_block(M) of E*(M)→H*(BDiff̃⁺(M);Q), and determine how it compares with K_smooth(M)=ker[E*(M)→H*(BDiff⁺(M);Q)] (so K_block(M)⊂K_smooth(M)).
